record.category: usenet provider (Omicron/Base IP backbone, EU retail)

free_tier.stated: No free tier and no trial stated in prose. The plans page carries a checkout option id 'Ultimate-VPN-12Mo-FreeTrial-50GB', which suggests a 50 GB trial exists on the 12-month Ultimate plan, but no sentence on the page describes it.

per_object_cap.stated: no per-object cap is published; no per-object cap is published; the unit of retrieval is a Usenet article, approximately 750 KB by convention, so 1 TiB of monthly transfer corresponds to roughly 1.4 million article…

retention.stated: 6,000 Days article retention, in the plan table

egress.terms: Unlimited downloads on every plan; speed is capped by tier rather than by volume

record.interface_detail: NNTP over TLS on port 563. No HTTP or object API exists for the download path, which is driven through SABnzbd, NZBGet or nzbdav.
record.chaining: A low-speed primary for a client whose line is under 50 Mbit on the Fast tier; it stacks with an Abavia block for completion and duplicates the Omicron spool if paired with Newshosting.

limits.value: 30 connections on Fast, 40 on Lightning, 60 on Ultimate + VPN
50 Mbit on Fast, 100 Mbit on Lightning, unlimited on Ultimate + VPN

record.limits_note: Annual prices from the plan table: Fast EUR 69.95 (EUR 5.83/mo), Lightning EUR 89.95 (EUR 7.50/mo), Ultimate + VPN EUR 108.78 (EUR 9.07/mo). Monthly prices seen in the same page markup are EUR 7.95, 9.95 and 12.95; the table shows the 12-month term by default.
record.binding_note: Ultimate + VPN is unlimited speed and unlimited volume with 60 connections; no fair-use number is published, so nothing in the vocabulary binds at 1 TiB/month.

identity_cost.detail: Email plus a paid plan. No card-free path is described; the only trial signal is a checkout option id with no prose.

record.reliability_note: Base IP BV infrastructure (AS34305), the Dutch arm of the Omicron group. A cached virtual version of the Eweka spool rather than a fourth independent archive.
record.confidence_note: Plan prices, speeds, connections and retention come from the vendor's own plan table markup read. The trial is left unclaimed because no prose supports it.

evidence.proved: Fast 50 Mbit 30 connections EUR 69.95/yr; Lightning 100 Mbit 40 connections EUR 89.95/yr; Ultimate + VPN unlimited 60 connections EUR 108.78/yr; 6,000 days
Page markup carries span[data-id=Ultimate-VPN-12Mo-FreeTrial-50GB], pre-selected by script

record.notes: The 50 Mbit cap on Fast is the reason the cheapest plan is not the cheapest plan here: at 12.5 MB/s 1 TiB of monthly transfer needs about 24 hours of wall clock, and a single connection cannot use more than that.
